blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements for Risk360. To see scheduled maintenance updates for your cloud, visit the Trust Portal.
You can access the following risk-related reports and documents from the Reports page in the Risk360 Admin Portal:
See image.
To learn more, see Downloading Risk Reports.
You can view event logs that contribute to score changes across Risk360 categories and factors from the Score Change Logs tab on the Audit Logs page (Administration > Audit Logs > Score Change Logs).
See image.
To learn more, see About Audit Logs.

You can analyze your organization's risk with the MITRE ATT&CK framework, a cybersecurity framework funded by the government that is used to detect, identify, and classify various tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) used for cyber attacks by attackers. The new MITRE ATT&CK page (Frameworks > MITRE ATT&CK) helps you with assessing your organization's security posture and calculating the risk of a cyber attack.
See image.
To learn more, see Analyzing Risk With MITRE ATT&CK.

The Risk360 service supports the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) cybersecurity framework (CSF), a set of recommendations and processes that you can implement and follow to strengthen your organization's security posture against malicious attackers that also guides how to respond and recover from an event of security breach. Considered a very high-standard risk management tool across the industry as it provides great value at any stage of your cybersecurity journey.
See image.
To learn more, see Analyzing Risk With NIST CSF.

The Risk360 Admin Portal supports the Monte Carlo Simulation (Financial Risk > Monte Carlo Simulation) to show you the probability of loss for various risk scores (i.e., inherent risk, residual risk, etc.).
See image.
To learn more, see Quantifying Loss With Monte Carlo Simulation.

blocks.heading: Access Zscaler Admin Portals From Risk360

blocks.text: You can access various Zscaler admin portals from the Risk360 drop-down in the left-side navigation and the Factors page to manage your configuration and policies as per Risk360's recommendations to reduce attack risk.
See image.
To learn more, see Accessing and Navigating the Risk360 Admin Portal and About Factors.
The Risk360 service records the login name and IP address of every user who logs in to the Risk360 Admin Portal and adds or modifies configurations.
See image
To learn more, see About Audit Logs.

blocks.heading: Support for SAML Authenticaton for Risk360 Admins

blocks.text: The Risk360 service supports identity provider (IdP)-initiated SAML authentication for admins. You can configure SAML for Risk360 admins with Okta.
To learn more, see SAML Configuration Guide for Okta.

Risk360 is a 360-degree risk management platform that holistically measures, quantifies, and helps remediate risky activities from various entities, configurations, and external attack surface data from your overall Zscaler environment to provide the most comprehensive and actionable risk framework the industry has to offer.
Enabling Risk360 for your organization allows you to:

blocks.item: Analyze your organization's security data to get real-time risk metrics and quantification.
Gain in-depth visibility into your risky assets and configurations.
Glance at your organization's risk from financial, industry standards, and peer perspectives.
Mitigate risk exposure by performing actionable recommendations through intuitive workflows.

blocks.text: To learn more, see What Is Risk360?
